name: column-chart
title: Column Chart
author: Almas Kasymzhanov <almaskasymzhanov@gmail.com>
description: Time-series vertical bars. Tufte data-ink discipline — one accent, no gridlines. Monospace numerics (Hack), pixel-font label badges (Departure Mono), built-in source attribution and ASCII empty state. Zero dependencies beyond React. WCAG AA accessible with roving tabindex, ARIA Graphics roles, and hidden table summary for screen readers.
